title: Coverage Start, Term and Expiry under Northgate Protect Plans
content:
Coverage of a single-item Northgate Protect plan starts on the fulfilment date of the covered item, the date it was picked up, delivered or bought at the register, and runs for the tier's coverage term in calendar months: the coverage end date is the start date plus the term months (falling back to the last day of a shorter month) and the last covered day is the day before it.

On activation the covered item is registered and its net price becomes the limit of liability. — *This clause is no longer in force; it is superseded by the current basis for registering a covered item and its limit of liability.*

If the item is canceled or returned before it is fulfilled, the plan is canceled before start with a full refund. Northgate Protect Complete Monthly coverage starts on the enrollment date; it registers every eligible item fulfilled from Northgate orders placed within the tier's look-back days before enrollment and every eligible item fulfilled while it is active, each on its fulfilment date or the enrollment date, whichever is later. Where the tier's waiting period is above zero and the plan was bought after the item was fulfilled, no claim with an incident date inside the waiting period is covered. A single-item plan expires at the end of its term; Complete Monthly runs month to month until canceled or lapsed. The start event follows the tier's coverage start basis.

## Coverage dates, worked

| Hypothetical start date | Term | Coverage end date | Last covered day |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 April | 24 months | 10 April, two years later | 9 April, two years later |
| 31 August | 36 months | 31 August, three years later | 30 August, three years later |
| 29 February of a leap year | 24 months | 28 February, two years later, the last day of the shorter month | 27 February, two years later |

## Registration date on Complete Monthly

| Item | Registered on |
|---|---|
| Fulfilled before enrollment, from an order placed within the look-back days | The enrollment date |
| Fulfilled after enrollment while Complete Monthly is active | Its fulfilment date |

## Waiting period

| Plan bought | Tier's waiting period | Incident inside the waiting period |
|---|---|---|
| After the item was fulfilled | Above zero | Not covered |
| After the item was fulfilled | Zero | No waiting period applies |
| Before or on fulfilment | Any | No waiting period applies |

superseded_clauses: On activation the covered item is registered and its net price becomes the limit of liability.
